key_patterns: 1. Server components live in src/app/**/page.tsx and fetch via prisma directly. 2. Client components have 'use client' at the top. 3. useLanguage() from @/context/LanguageContext gives { lang, setLang, t }. 4. t('key') returns translated string. 5. All translation keys live in src/context/LanguageContext.tsx in the `translations` object. 6. ProductCard, AddToCartButton, SortSelect, QuantitySelector, CartItemRow are all client components already ('use client'). 7. Navbar is a server component but uses LanguageSwitcher (client) — no change needed there. 8. CartItemRow hardcodes 'Remove'; AddToCartButton hardcodes 'Add to Cart', 'Added!', 'Out of Stock'; QuantitySelector hardcodes 'Add to Cart', 'Added to Cart!', 'Quantity:'; SortSelect hardcodes sort option labels.
directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages (server components). src/components/ — shared React components. src/context/ — React context providers (LanguageContext, ToastContext, WishlistContext). src/actions/ — Next.js server actions (cart.ts, orders.ts). src/lib/ — Prisma client, session helpers. prisma/ — schema.prisma + seed. .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts.
